runique_test.not_a_transaction: the test didn't run inside a transaction, so nothing could be rolled back
runique_test.nested: runique_test can't run inside another runique_test: it would wait for its own caller forever
runique_test.timed_out: the handler didn't finish within {} s: a deadlock, or a row another connection keeps locked? RUNIQUE_TEST_TIMEOUT in the env file changes the limit
runique_test.bad_timeout: {} must be a whole number of seconds above 0, got "{}"
runique_test.transaction_ended: the test's transaction was ended from inside the test (a COMMIT, or DDL on MariaDB/MySQL): everything written before that is now in the database
runique_test.swallowed_failures: failed queries: {}, yet the handler returned Ok: an error got swallowed somewhere (wrap the failures you expect in expect_db_error)
runique_test.rollback_timed_out: the rollback didn't finish within {} s
runique_test.not_refused: the database accepted what the test expected it to refuse
runique_test.no_db_config: the env file sets neither DATABASE_URL nor DB_ENGINE: the test database has to be named in it, nothing is taken from the shell
runique_test.in_memory: in-memory: every test starts from an empty database

test_runner.no_cargo_toml: No Cargo.toml here: run `runique test` from your project's root.
test_runner.test_utils_missing:
The `test-utils` feature isn't enabled for runique in Cargo.toml.
Add it as a dev-dependency so it never ends up in a release build:
    cargo add --dev runique --features test-utils
test_runner.test_utils_shipped:
Cargo.toml enables `test-utils` outside of [dev-dependencies], so the test builder would end up in your release build.
Remove it from [dependencies] (and from any [features] entry), then add it as a dev-dependency only:
    cargo add --dev runique --features test-utils
test_runner.no_mod_file: No src/runique_test/mod.rs: create it, then declare each test file in it (`mod user;`).
test_runner.module_not_gated:
The runique_test module isn't behind `cfg(test)`, so it would end up in every build.
Put `#[cfg(test)]` right above `mod runique_test;` in src/main.rs.
test_runner.file_not_declared_warning: warning: src/runique_test/{}.rs isn't declared in mod.rs, so its tests won't run. Add `mod {};` to mod.rs.
test_runner.file_not_declared: src/runique_test/{}.rs isn't declared in mod.rs: add `mod {};` to it.
